title: Interconnected Organisms and Chemicals in Various Relationships
summary: This cluster consists of 12 organisms and 2 chemicals. The organisms are connected through involvement relationships, forming a web of interactions. For example, Best is involved in Hanson, and Chapman is involved in Best. The chemicals GABA and Sulfotransferases are involved in specific organisms, such as Wu and Wong, respectively. The relationships between the organisms are complex, with some organisms involved in multiple other organisms, creating a network of interactions.
